## Summary of Identity & Career

He specializes in architecting high-throughput enterprise web systems, production Linux VPS cloud hosting infrastructure (Nginx, PM2, SSL/TLS, UFW firewall), statutory payroll calculation engines processing 150,000+ employees, and zero-trust security authentication platforms.
